result.paraphrase: Powered by a GeForce GT 1030, this card includes 2GB of 64-bit GDDR5 memory and HDMI support for 4K at 60Hz. It delivers smooth 4K video playback and HTML5 browsing, with one-click overclocking through AORUS Graphics Engine. Core clock speeds are Boost 1544 MHz / Base 1290 MHz in OC Mode, and Boost 1518 MHz / Base 1265 MHz in Gaming Mode. Built on NVIDIA Pascal, the GIGABYTE GeForce GT 1030 handles casual gaming and smooth 4K playback, with factory overclocking and efficient cooling for improved performance. High-quality chokes and capacitors enhance durability and reliability. The custom cooler uses an 80mm fan and an aluminum base for effective heat dissipation at lower temperatures. Featuring one DVI-D port and one gold-plated HDMI port, it supports crisp 4K video output. The intuitive AORUS Graphics Engine utility lets users adjust clock speeds, voltage, fan performance, and power target in real time, and with one click, gamers can tune the card to suit their needs without any overclocking experience.
